lesson_title: CloudWatch: The CCTV and Alarm System

ava_lesson_intro.ava_speaks: CS1B · CloudWatch: The CCTV and Alarm System. Ren teaching mode on.

lines: CloudWatch: The CCTV and Alarm System

blocks.ava_speaks: EC2, S3, IAM, VPC — நாலு pillars முடிஞ்சிடுச்சு. We built a secure, scalable app. But உங்களோட Swiggy clone night 2 AM-க்கு crash ஆனா, உங்களுக்கு எப்படி தெரியும்? Users Twitter-ல திட்டுனதுக்கு அப்பறம் தான் தெரியுமா? That brings us to our final pillar: Amazon CloudWatch.
blocks.speaker: Ren

blocks.ava_speaks: CloudWatch is the CCTV camera and alarm system for your entire AWS account. Your servers, your databases, your network — everything that happens, CloudWatch continuously watches it.

board_actions.text: The CCTV and Alarm system of your cloud.

whiteboard_data.heading: Pillar 5: Amazon CloudWatch
points: The CCTV and Alarm system of your cloud.

blocks.speaker: Ren

blocks.ava_speaks: Let's take a real scenario. Flipkart Big Billion Days sale நடக்குது. திடீர்னு ஒரு EC2 server-ஓட CPU 100% hit ஆகி hang ஆகிடுச்சு. Developers தூங்கிட்டு இருக்காங்க. Morning 8 AM தான் crash ஆனதே தெரிஞ்சா? Massive business loss.
blocks.speaker: Ren

blocks.ava_speaks: To fix this, CloudWatch collects 'Metrics'. Metrics-னா data points. CPU usage எவ்ளோ இருக்கு, எவ்ளோ error codes வருது, network traffic எவ்ளோ — இதெல்லாம் CloudWatch second-by-second record பண்ணிட்டே இருக்கும்.

board_actions.text: Examples: CPU Utilization, Network In/Out, Error Rates.
Acts like a continuous health check.

whiteboard_data.heading: CloudWatch Metrics
points: Examples: CPU Utilization, Network In/Out, Error Rates.
Acts like a continuous health check.

blocks.speaker: Ren

blocks.ava_speaks: But CCTV recording-அ உக்காந்து 24/7 பாத்துட்டே இருக்க முடியாது. So we create 'Alarms'. Example: 'CPU 85% மேல போனா எனக்கு உடனே சொல்லு' னு ஒரு threshold set பண்ணலாம்.
blocks.speaker: Ren

blocks.ava_speaks: When that alarm triggers, CloudWatch automatically sends an SMS, Email, or a PagerDuty alert to the on-call engineer's phone. 2 AM problem, 2:01 AM-க்கு detect ஆகிடும். This is how real companies maintain 99.9% uptime.

board_actions.text: Sends SMS/Emails to on-call engineers instantly.

whiteboard_data.heading: CloudWatch Alarms
points: Sends SMS/Emails to on-call engineers instantly.

blocks.speaker: Ren

blocks.ava_speaks: So, CloudWatch is your ultimate safety net. Concepts clear-ஆ? You are now ready to configure this service in the real terminal.
blocks.speaker: Ren

workspace_tasks.question: BookMyShow's backend servers are crashing because 5 lakh people are trying to book tickets for a blockbuster movie at the exact same time. What should the engineering team have configured to get notified *before* the servers completely crash?
options: A dedicated junior engineer assigned to stare at the server dashboard 24/7.
A CloudWatch Alarm monitoring EC2 CPU Metrics, set to send an SMS/PagerDuty alert to the on-call engineer when CPU hits 85%.
An IAM Policy to automatically ban users when traffic gets too high.
A Public Subnet to automatically allow more internet traffic into the database.
workspace_tasks.ava_feedback_correct: 5 manual- monitor doing impossible. CloudWatch Alarm set do, CPU 85% touch on-call engineer- SMS/alert. Server crash fix do.
workspace_tasks.ava_feedback_wrong: 5 manual- monitor doing impossible. CloudWatch Alarm set do, CPU 85% touch on-call engineer- SMS/alert. Server crash fix do.
workspace_tasks.explanation: 5 manual- monitor doing impossible. CloudWatch Alarm set do, CPU 85% touch on-call engineer- SMS/alert. Server crash fix do.

workspace_tasks.question: TicketRush sees CPU on the booking fleet climb every evening but nobody is paged until users tweet 'site down.' Eng lead asks you to separate 'watching the number' from 'waking a human.' Which pairing is correct?
options: Metric = IAM rule; Alarm = VPC route.
Metric = continuous raw measurement (e.g. CPU %); Alarm = automated rule that pages when that metric crosses a threshold.
Metric terminates the instance; Alarm only restarts it.
Metric and Alarm are synonyms for the same CloudWatch camera.
workspace_tasks.ava_feedback_correct: Metric = the CCTV feed (CPU %). Alarm = the siren when it crosses 85%. TicketRush needed both — watching alone doesn't wake anyone.
workspace_tasks.ava_feedback_wrong: Don't conflate them. Record the metric always; fire the alarm only when the threshold says the on-call should act.
workspace_tasks.explanation: Metric = continuous raw measurement; Alarm = threshold → action. Watching alone doesn't page humans.
